nom: SKIN1004 Lab in Nature Niacinamide 10 Boosting Shot Ampoule

avis.titre: Great product to add to skincare routine
avis.texte: Using this in my routine has made my skin glow and definitely makes it brighter after constant use.

avis.titre: It's okay, but I'm not blown away
avis.texte: I've only used this a few times so far, so I haven't noticed a huge difference yet. It feels nice going on and is easy to add to my skincare routine, but I'd probably need to use it longer to know if it really makes a difference for my skin.

This product has such cute packaging. It instantly makes me feel like I'm using a high-end product. It goes on great and I had no issues with the drop applicator. I like the way it makes my skin feel and it doesn't cause any make up to pill.

I've been loving this niacinamide serum! It goes on so smoothly, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or greasy. My skin looks brighter, more even, and feels noticeably smoother and hydrated. It's also been really easy to add into my everyday skincare routine. Definitely a new favorite and one I'll keep repurchasing!
I really enjoyed this and love this brand. I saw improvement in skin moisture and reducing redness. Would definitely purchase again.

Niacinamide is almost in everything nowadays. However, this didn't bother my skin. It actually hydrated and gave my skin a boost in moisture. Usually I use the VT reedle shot and then apply serum, but this saves more time by putting it all together. I would recommend this product if you feel like your skin needs a boost of hydration. It's a small bottle, but it's well packaged and a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: I would recommend and buy again!
avis.texte: I've tried other serums that claim to hydrate or to even out skin tone. Although I don't know if I've used this serum long enough to see any brighting effects I do think that my skin feels smoother and more hydrated when I use it.

Love love loving this product. It feels so nice on my skin and I have noticed a difference in my skin since I started using it. Ive used about half of the bottle. Ive worked it into my skin care routine and I plan to purchase another bottle soon. Highly reccomend!

I received this free product in exchange for my honest review. I've really liked this serum! It feels lightweight, sinks in fast, and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. After using it for a little while, my skin looks brighter and smoother, and it gives me a nice glow. I'd definitely use it again!

I've been using niacinamide 10 boosting shot ampoule for about a month. My skin is noticeably brighter and has a consistent tone. I've been getting a lot of comments about that too! It's been the perfect product as I've been prepping for my wedding and just trying to improve my skin overall. I have sensitive skin so it did make my skin a bit red (just after application, the redness did not last) in the beginning, but that has lessened over time. I'd recommend using it 2-3x a week to start. I really love this product and I will be continuing to use it in my skin care routine!

I have been using this for a month or so and have been enjoying the way my skin feels. I feel hydrated but not oily only sticky. Applied in the evenings to clean skin, it fits perfectly into my routine.

avis.titre: This is a nice addition to a routine
avis.texte: This is a great addition to my skin care routine. The dropper makes it easy to apply and sits well at night under my moisturizer. It makes my skin feel fresh and brighter and the ingredients help make sure my skin isn't dried out from using it. I've been using it 3 times a week and so far love the results

I am really enjoying this product. I like to apply if on clean skin after showering. I makes my skin feel very clean and smooth. I am not sure if it is working because it's too soon to tell but I have noticed my dark spot on one of my cheeks started to lighten a tiny bit. The application is very easy as it is a dropper. The wand is a bit curved which is perfect to apply directly to the face without creating a mess. This product is not very thick so skin absorbs it fairly quick. I love that it does not leave my skin greasy.

avis.titre: The glow and softness is real
avis.texte: I've tried many different ampoules before and I got this one as a gift and not for nothing but they nailed it! I started using it like a month ago and my skin was feeling weird like not smooth and rather uneven but after using this it feels and looks like a teenager skin once again and I'm loving it. Doesn't really have scent which I appreciate since I have sensitive skin, didn't give me any reactions and is a must have for my overall skin routine. Now I want to try more products from this brand. If your skin needs that little extra help, this is the one.
my skin literally never looked better I am by far impressed with my results if healthy younger skin is what you're looking for grab it
I enjoy this product because it feels light and natural. Niacinamide helps brighten the complexion and the formula is non irritating. I received this as a gift for my honest review.

I've been using this product for a couple weeks. I haven't really noticed any visible improvements yet, but I also haven't noticed any issues which is nice. Seems like a simple and pretty straight forward niacinamide. I can say that it does slightly reduce sebum production so not looking as oily after a long day at work. Will continue to use this. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Glowy, healthy skin here I come
avis.texte: I have been using and loving this Skin1004 Lab In Nature Niacinamide boosting shop ampoule for a couple weeks now and I have been impressed by its affects on my skin. I use it as my second step before moisturizing daily and it makes my skin hydrated and glowing right after application. I have also noticed over the two weeks, that my pores have shrunk and my skin is getting more even toned. This is definitely a serum I am going to keep in my skin care routine.

Ladies and gentlemen, I am here to tell you that if you want glass skin, the Lab in Nature Niacinimide 10 Boosting Shot Ampoule is the product you need to have in your skincare routine! I apply mine in the evening after washing my face and applying my toner and it has given me the most glassy skin I've ever had! Highly recommend !

I always like to wait and use the product for a week or 2 before reviewing so it's an honest review. Honestly from the 2nd use i noticed my skin was smother in the morning and clearer and the pores were smaller and the blackheads in my nose were less. All in all a great product honestly j didn't expect it to work this good and it's very light and not sticky and whatever the leftover from my hands goes down my neck and back of the hands
I love this serum so much, especially of you have oily skin, it helps with oil control and it also has exosomes so it's going to help with texture and acne marks and uneven skintone.

This product brightened the tone of my skin and minimized my pore appearance. It soothes and calms the skin, fades dark spots and 100% boosts luminosity. My face feels moisturized and the overall feel is just amazing. 10/10 will always recommend.

The Niacinamide 10 Boosting Shot is a great addition to my skincare routine. It does not make my skin feel sticky or dry it out. My skin feels smooth after applying. I will definitely keep this in my routine.

My skin loved this ampoule! My face felt smooth and looked so hydrated. I have sensitive skin on my face and had no bad reaction or any pimples! I have combination skin and no greasy feel or over drying. I definitely would purchase this ampoule! I received many compliments on my complexion too! I made sure to press it into my face instead of massaging it in. Makes a huge difference. This ampoule is in my top 10 for sure.

I've been really impressed with this ampoule. It has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without leaving my skin feeling sticky. After using it consistently, my complexion looks brighter, smoother, and more even. It also helps reduce the appearance of dark spots and makes my pores look less noticeable. Despite the 10% niacinamide, it feels gentle on my skin and doesn't cause irritation. My skin feels hydrated, healthy, and has a natural glow.

I received this in exchange for my honest review. I am loving this serum! I love the texture of it and how well it absorbs into my skin. My skin is brighter and smoother and absolutely glowing since I've started using it in just a short amount of time. I cannot recommend it enough!
I have noticed my skin is much brighter and glowier since I started using Lab in Nature Niacinamide 10 together with the 2% BHA Exfoliant

avis.titre: Makes my face soft and plump
avis.texte: I'm 40 years old and I usually have problems with face serums creams etc. Normally I get super oily no matter what I use. Not this stuff. It also seemingly overnight made my face appear plump(not the sunken in tired eyes I'm getting so used to nowadays haha). I've noticed it makes my skin super soft too,like baby soft. Definitely love and recommend!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review and I LOVED trialing this serum. I am a serum and skincare enthusiast, typically using high end brands with scientific backing. This product didn't disappoint. You use a small amount, and I could easily see decreased redness, oiliness and pore size within two days of use. After 2 weeks my skin was so refreshed and beautiful without makeup. I will be buying in future as a regular part of my regimen. No adverse effects were noted whereas with some brands I can tend to break out. So that was a win that it was a clean, gentle, effective product.

Skin1004 is a beautiful brand I've been using for years now. This lovely product has 10% niacinamide to help brighten skin, and even out skin tone. Helps to refine pores as well. I received this complimentary in exchange for my honest review.

I was given this in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this serum in my regular skincare routine after my toner for a few weeks now. I needed a switch up. I have noticed a drastic change in texture, as my skin is noticeably smoother, and I'm have less bumps. My pores are starting to look less visible. I will continue to use this product and recommend it!!
I love this product. It feels light on my skin and absorbs quickly.
I've been using this boosting shot for a few weeks now and my skin has been looking so smooth and shiny in all the best ways! My skin has never looked better!

avis.titre: Great first step for smooth skin
avis.texte: I really like using this as the first step after cleansing. It has a slight tingly feeling that makes it seem like it's gently exfoliating, and it leaves my skin feeling fresh, smooth, hydrated, and just a little firmer. It layers well under my serums and moisturizer and has become a staple in my routine.

Ok this niacinamide shot is actually so good?? Sinks in super fast, doesn't feel sticky or heavy at all so it's easy to layer with the rest of my routine. I started noticing my skin looking brighter and more even within like a week, and my pores seem smaller too. Zero breakouts which is huge because my skin sometimes freaks out with new products. Also the bottle is small but a little goes SO far, definitely gonna last me a while. 100% repurchasing.

I received this product in exchange for my review. I used this in both my AM and PM skin routine. It's very hydrating which is crucial for me since I'm on tretinoin. This pairs along wonderfully with it and moisturizes my skin which tends to dry up when I put on the tretinoin. I highly recommend this product as it provides deep hydration for the skin, it feels nice and silky on my skin, and it's a good sized bottle. It should last about a month.

I was sent this Lab in Nature Niacinamide 10 Boosting Shot Ampoule to test. I love Niacidamide for helping reduce my pores and combat my oily skin. I have sensitive skin so I have to watch everything I test. So far, no increased breakouts which is a huge plus! I cleanse my face, then use a toning pad. I use a drop of the niacinamide before putting on my moisturizer. Definitely going to continue using in my nighttime routine.

avis.titre: Now Part of my everyday routine
avis.texte: I fell in love with this product. It doesn't make my skin feel too oily, and it has brightened and tightened my skin within weeks

I've been using this serum daily and it layers really well with the rest of my skincare. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. I like that it gives my skin a smoother look and helps keep my complexion looking more even over time. It also works well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling.
